pro_pitch: I build web apps, Python automation tools and video edits for clients who want clean, working results.
pro_s1_d: Responsive websites and dashboards in JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
pro_s2_d: Tools that organize files and media and remove repetitive work.
pro_s3_d: Digital media production with Adobe Premiere Pro.
w1_d: Arabic learning platform front end: student dashboard, courses, interactive exams and a Q&A forum. A static demo: data is saved in the browser and there is no backend yet.
w2_d: Arabic-first, right-to-left website for a fictional bakery. Responsive layout, product category filter, mobile menu and a contact form with client-side validation. No frameworks.
w3_d: Arabic tasks and notes app with categories, priorities, due dates with overdue flags, inline editing, search, filters, keyboard support, and JSON export/import. Runs in the browser and keeps data locally.
w4: Also in development: Python tools for organizing media and files (Media Organizer Pro, Smart File Organizer).
w5_d: Demo site for a dental clinic: services, team, FAQ and a booking form with validation. Fictional clinic, no real data is collected.
w6_d: Demo store with category filter, live search and a working cart that remembers your items. Fictional products, no payment.
w7_d: Five-page English marketing site for a fictional consulting firm: services, insights and a contact form with validation. All names and figures are made up.
w8_d: Python command-line tool that reads a paginated product listing and writes a clean CSV and Excel file. Retries, polite delays, robots.txt check, 13 automated tests.
w9_d: Browser invoice builder with live totals, tax, discount and currency. Prints to PDF. Demo only; 10 browser checks.
w10_d: Property search with filters, sorting and a saved-favourites list that persists in the browser. Fictional listings; 13 browser checks.
w11_d: Single-product landing page for a fictional lamp: interactive light slider, FAQ, validated form. Nothing is sent. 10 browser checks.
w20_d: Log spending, set a budget per category and export CSV. Data stays in your browser. 13 browser checks.
w21_d: Remove blank rows and duplicates, filter, sort and download. The file never leaves your browser. 12 browser checks.
w22_d: Timer or manual entries, totals per project, timesheet CSV. Data stays in your browser. 12 browser checks.
w23_d: Build a client quote with discount, tax and templates; copy as text or print to PDF. 14 browser checks.
w24_d: Daily ticks, streaks and a 14-day view with CSV export. Data stays in your browser. 13 browser checks.
w25_d: Opens WhatsApp with a ready booking request. It sends a request only; the business confirms. 23 browser checks.
